note: Lixa Agent's map of the app: one entry per screen (id = the router route). The build fails if a route in ui/shell/Router.kt has no entry here. 'open': false means the screen only opens from a saved item, never directly.

entries.title: Lixa
entries.purpose: The home chat with Lixa: clinical, academic and app questions, and creating files by asking.
inputs: optional attachments: PDF, Word, images, audio, camera, a pasted link
actions: create a file with @ and a tool name
export an answer to PDF, Word or PowerPoint
open past chats and files from History
howTo: Tap Lixa in the bottom bar.
Type a message, or tap the mic to dictate.
Tap + to attach a file.
Type @ to pick a tool, or /word, /pdf or /powerpoint to get a file.

entries.title: Workspace
entries.purpose: All tools as cards, the current plan, and frequently asked questions.
actions: send feedback with a star rating
howTo: Tap Workspace in the bottom bar.
Tap a tool card to open it. The most used tools rise to the top.

entries.title: Smart EMR
entries.purpose: Patient records: registration, intake, SI clinical summaries, treatment plans, session notes, progress notes and discharge summaries.
actions: write a session or progress note
switch between personal and center records
howTo: Open Workspace, then Smart EMR.
Tap the add button to register a patient, or tap a patient to open the record.
Inside a record, use the tabs for intake, plans, notes and discharge.

entries.title: Motion & Gait Analyzer
entries.purpose: Camera-based, voice-guided assessment of joint range of motion, gait and assistive devices, with a report.
actions: measure a joint's range of motion
howTo: Open Workspace, then Motion & Gait.
Choose the assessment type at the top.
Allow the camera, follow the spoken guidance, then read the report.

entries.title: Audio Transcription
entries.purpose: Records or uploads a session and turns it into a transcript and session narrative; Coach mode supports a live session.
inputs: a live recording or an audio file
session details: patient, session type, profession
actions: set session details under the sliders icon
link a transcript to an EMR patient
howTo: Open Workspace, then Audio Transcription.
Choose Record live or Upload Audio.
Tap the sliders icon to add session details.
Tap to record, and tap stop when finished.

entries.title: Deck Studio
entries.purpose: Designs PowerPoint decks from a topic or notes, with a preview, restyling and a .pptx download.
howTo: Open Workspace, then Deck Studio.
Enter the topic or paste notes, then choose audience, slide count and style.
Tap create, review the preview, then download.

entries.title: Presentation Maker
entries.purpose: Writes case presentations, clinical reports and documentation from notes.
actions: open the result in the editor
howTo: Open Workspace, then Presentation Maker.
Choose the kind of document and enter the notes.
Tap generate; the result opens in the editor.

entries.title: Assessment Format
entries.purpose: Generates printable assessment forms for a condition or speciality.
howTo: Open Workspace, then Assessment Format.
Enter the condition and details, then tap generate.
The form opens ready to edit, print or export.

entries.title: Standardized Tools
entries.purpose: Full standardized outcome measures and scales, ready to use.
inputs: the name of the outcome measure or what needs measuring
howTo: Open Workspace, then Standardized Tools.
Search or enter the measure you need, then tap generate.

entries.title: Assignment Maker
entries.purpose: Writes referenced academic assignments and write-ups.
actions: open the result in the editor
howTo: Open Workspace, then Assignment Maker.
Enter the topic and requirements, then tap generate.

entries.title: Project Maker
entries.purpose: A full research project, chapters 1 to 5, with Project SI, review and export.
actions: switch between personal and center projects
howTo: Open Workspace, then Project Maker.
Create a project and enter the topic.
Open a chapter and tap generate; use Project SI for questions and review.

entries.title: Study Buddy
entries.purpose: Flashcards, summaries and quizzes made from the user's notes.
howTo: Open Workspace, then Study Buddy.
Paste notes or enter a topic, choose flashcards, summary or quiz, then tap generate.

entries.title: Exam Simulator
entries.purpose: Timed SI-generated practice exams with analytics on weak areas.
actions: switch between personal and center subjects
howTo: Open Workspace, then Exam Simulator.
Pick a subject, the number of questions, the duration and difficulty.
Tap Generate Exam, answer, then submit to see the analysis.

entries.title: Settings
entries.purpose: Account settings: profile, theme, center and organisation, notifications, legal documents, logout and account deletion.
howTo: Tap the profile picture in the top bar, then Settings.
Scroll to the section you need: Center & Organization, Notifications, or Account.

entries.title: Subscription Plans
entries.purpose: Shows the plans (Free, Basic, Pro, Max) with prices for the user's country, and where to upgrade.
howTo: Open Workspace and tap the plan card, or tap Upgrade wherever it appears.
Choose monthly or yearly, then the plan.

entries.title: Rehablix Partner
entries.purpose: The partner programme: apply, get a referral link, and see referrals, commissions and payouts.
howTo: Tap the profile picture in the top bar, then Rehablix Partner.

entries.title: Result editor
entries.purpose: The editor a generated presentation, report or assignment opens in: edit, share a link, print, save as PDF, export to Word or PowerPoint.
howTo: Generate something in Presentation Maker or Assignment Maker, or open it from History, Files.
Use the buttons at the top to share, print or export.

entries.title: Documentation result
entries.purpose: The viewer and editor for generated documentation and standardized tools.
howTo: Generate documentation or a standardized tool, or open it from History, Files.

entries.title: Assessment Format view
entries.purpose: Shows a generated assessment form, ready to edit, print or export.
howTo: Generate a form in Assessment Format, or open one from its History.

entries.title: Audio Transcript
entries.purpose: Shows a saved transcript and its session narrative.
howTo: Finish a recording in Audio Transcription, or open a transcript from its History.

entries.title: Presentation export
entries.purpose: Turns a finished presentation or report into PowerPoint slides for download.
inputs: a result opened from the editor
howTo: Open a result in the editor and choose export to PowerPoint.
